import bpy, math, os
from pathlib import Path
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT')
bpy.ops.object.delete(use_global=False)
bpy.ops.object.armature_add(enter_editmode=True, location=(0,0,0))
rig=bpy.context.object
rig.name='ProbeRig'
bone=rig.data.edit_bones[0]
bone.name='ProbeBone'
bone.head=(0,0,0)
bone.tail=(0,0,2)
bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode='OBJECT')
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=(0,0,1))
mesh=bpy.context.object
mesh.name='WeightedProbe'
mesh.scale=(0.3,0.3,2.0)
bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=False, rotation=False, scale=True)
mesh.parent=rig
weights=mesh.vertex_groups.new(name='ProbeBone')
weights.add(list(range(len(mesh.data.vertices))),1.0,'REPLACE')
modifier=mesh.modifiers.new(name='ProbeSkin',type='ARMATURE')
modifier.object=rig
pose=rig.pose.bones['ProbeBone']
pose.rotation_mode='XYZ'
for frame,angle in [(1,-0.7),(13,0.7),(25,-0.7)]:
    pose.rotation_euler=(angle,0,0)
    pose.keyframe_insert(data_path='rotation_euler',frame=frame)
rig.animation_data.action.name='ProbeSwing'
bpy.context.scene.frame_start=1
bpy.context.scene.frame_end=25
bpy.context.scene.render.fps=24
bpy.context.scene.frame_set(13)
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
mesh.select_set(True)
rig.select_set(True)
bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active=rig
folder=Path('{{ROOT}}/.local/mcp-fixture')
source_folder=Path('{{ROOT}}/.local/blender-sources')
source_folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=str(source_folder/'probe_swing.blend'))
props=bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf.get_rna_type().properties
assert all(n in props for n in ['filepath','export_format','use_selection','export_animations'])
result=bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf(filepath=str(folder/'probe_swing.glb'),export_format='GLB',use_selection=True,export_animations=True,export_frame_range=True,export_force_sampling=True)
assert 'FINISHED' in result
print({'GLB_EXPORT_OK':True,'bytes':(folder/'probe_swing.glb').stat().st_size,'bones':len(rig.data.bones),'action':rig.animation_data.action.name})
